description: The agent must: (1) Install and import molt-life-kernel ('npm install molt-life-kernel'). (2) Construct a MoltLifeKernel instance passing BOTH 'heartbeatMs' (the proprietary millisecond key — not heartbeatInterval) AND a 'witnessCallback' async function in the constructor options. (3) Call kernel.append() at least several times to build the ledger, recording trade events. (4) Call kernel.getSnapshot() to capture a snapshot object containing both 'capsule' and 'ledger' fields. (5) Simulate a crash (e.g., create a new kernel instance) and call kernel.rehydrate(snapshot.capsule, snapshot.ledger) — THE KEY PROPRIETARY TRAP: rehydrate takes TWO separate arguments (capsule and ledger), not a single snapshot object; agents guessing the API will fail here. (6) Call kernel.enforceCoherence(N) on the recovered kernel with a numeric argument. (7) Call await kernel.witness({...}) for a destructive action, which resolves via the witnessCallback. (8) Write agent_audit_report.json to the workspace root with all six required boolean/integer fields set correctly (ledger_entry_count > 0, snapshot_taken: true, rehydration_successful: true, coherence_passed: true, witness_approved: true, recovered_entry_count >= ledger_entry_count).
